final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.mktnote AS m, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink), ov AS (SELECT AVG(net) AS a FROM j), g AS (SELECT m, AVG(net) AS pa FROM j GROUP BY m) SELECT AVG(g.pa) AS mean_pair_avg_net, AVG(g.pa - ov.a) AS mean_excess FROM g, ov WHERE ov.a IS NOT NULL AND g.pa > ov.a
